an3.13:1.1: tayome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.13:1.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā nesādakule vā veṇakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde appannapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
an3.13:1.6: so ca hoti, dubbaṇṇo duddasiko okoṭimako bavhābādho kāṇo vā kuṇī vā khañjo vā pakkhahato vā, na lābhī annassa pānassa vatthassa yānassa mālāgandhavilepanassa seyyāvasathapadīpeyyassa.
an3.13:1.8: itthannāmo kira khattiyo khattiyehi khattiyābhisekena abhisittoti.
an3.13:1.10: kudassu nāma mamampi khattiyā khattiyābhisekena abhisiñcissantīti.
an3.13:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa jeṭṭho putto hoti, ābhiseko anabhisitto macalappatto.
an3.13:2.4: itthannāmo kira khattiyo khattiyehi khattiyābhisekena abhisittoti.
an3.13:2.6: kudassu nāma mamampi khattiyā khattiyābhisekena abhisiñcissantīti.
an3.13:3.2: idha bhikkhave rājā hoti, khattiyo muddhāvasitto.
an3.13:3.4: itthannāmo kira khattiyo khattiyehi khattiyābhisekena abhisittoti.
an3.13:3.6: kudassu nāma mamampi khattiyā khattiyābhisekena abhisiñcissantīti.
an3.13:3.8: yā hissa bhikkhave pubbe anabhisittassa ābhisekāsā sāssa paṭippassaddhā.
an3.13:3.10: ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an3.13:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
an3.13:4.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti, pāpadhammo asuci saṃkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
an3.13:4.7: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an3.13:4.9: kudassu nāma ahampi āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmīti.
an3.13:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, kalyāṇadhammo.
an3.13:5.4: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an3.13:5.6: kudassu nāma ahampi āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmīti.
an3.13:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ hoti khīṇāsavo.
an3.13:6.4: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an3.13:6.6: kudassu nāma ahampi āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmīti.
an3.13:6.8: yā hissa bhikkhave pubbe avimuttassa vimuttāsā, sāssa paṭippassaddhā.
an3.13:6.10: ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsūti.
